data.title: Somerville residents track ownership behind planned Bitcoin mining center
data.description: Homeowners in Somerville have spent months attempting to identify the companies behind a planned 50-megawatt Bitcoin mining facility on Union Road. Their research has led them to a network of corporate entities connected to a Texas man.
data.keywords: Somerville Bitcoin mining center,VoltCore Alabama,Sovereign Gazelle LLC,Bitcoin mining facility Union Road,Kevin Mohan Sovereign Global Solutions
